title: DHCPv6: Update dissector and add functionality
description:
- Updated/aligned Options
- Updated/aligned Status Codes
- Typo fixes
- Obsolete options and status codes (draft-ietf-dhc-rfc8415bis)
- Add expert items for deprecated/obsoleted items
- Reformatting and addition of IANA references
- Display data bytes of unsupported options
- Added support for RFC 5970 (Network Boot)
- Added support for RFC 5678 (Mobility Services Discovery)
- Added support for RFC 6422 (Relay-Supplied Options)
- Added support for RFC 6607 (Virtual Subnet Selection)
- Added support for RFC 6610 (Home Information Discovery MIPv6)
- Added support for RFC 7037 (RADIUS)
- Added support for RFC 8947 (Link-Layer Address Assignment)
- Added support for RFC 9527 (Homenet Naming Authority)

notes.body: Why move these options?  Makes the diff unnecessarily large.
Just cosmetics to have the `value_string` near to the definitions.
Why remove these?  If they are obsolete they should be marked as such.  But I'm guessing there are existing captures that want these options dissected.

These options were based on a temporary IANA assignment which didn't make it into any standard with these IDs and the implemented logic.  
So, there is no chance that production code uses them.

It was a bit hard to find the origin and use case of the code and also the history in regards to IETF's Mobile IPv6 Home Discovery, but I think I finally found it.

It seems like all started with [draft-jang-dhc-haopt](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-jang-dhc-haopt/) which was renamed to draft-jang-mip6-hiopt. After it was picked up by IETF it was finally published as [RFC 6610](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6610/).

I think, I'll take some time to implement RFC 6610 rather than leaving the old implementation in  place.

commits_data.message:
DHCPv6: Update dissector and add functionality

- Updated/aligned Options
- Updated/aligned Status Codes
- Typo fixes
- Obsolete options and status codes (draft-ietf-dhc-rfc8415bis)
- Add expert items for deprecated/obsoleted items
- Reformatting and addition of IANA references
- Display data bytes of unsupported options
- Added support for RFC 5970 (Network Boot)
- Added support for RFC 5678 (Mobility Services Discovery)
- Added support for RFC 6422 (Relay-Supplied Options)
- Added support for RFC 6607 (Virtual Subnet Selection)
- Added support for RFC 6610 (Home Information Discovery MIPv6)
- Added support for RFC 7037 (RADIUS)
- Added support for RFC 8947 (Link-Layer Address Assignment)
- Added support for RFC 9527 (Homenet Naming Authority)
